subject: End-of-Q4: OKR scoring, evidence collection, and narrative ask
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.ai>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Cc: qbr-facilitator@consultco.com
Date: Mon, 07 Dec 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: End-of-Q4: OKR scoring, evidence collection, and narrative ask

Team —

As we close Q4, we need to lock OKR scores, collect final evidence, and assemble the narrative for the QBR. This thread is the authoritative landing spot for leadership judgments and cross-functional clarifications. Please read carefully and act against the deadlines below.

High-level asks (due EOD Wed 12/09):
- Populate the Q4 evidence sheet (linked) with 1–3 pieces of corroborating evidence per Key Result (metrics, dashboards, decks, product screenshots).
- Add a one-line justification for any score that deviates from +/–1 of the midline expectation.
- Flag KRs that require cross-team arbitration (reason + suggested adjudicator).

Scoring rubric (attached one-pager):
- 0 = Not achieved / no meaningful progress
- 1 = Partial progress / below expectation
- 2 = On-target / expected outcome
- 3 = Exceeded / materially beyond plan

Notes / priorities:
- For cross-functional KRs (growth <> infra <> ops), mark the owner and the most relevant metric to avoid double-counting.
- If evidence is proprietary (customer emails, contracts), add a stub note in the sheet and share the audit artifact via secure drive link.
- I will consolidate scores and publish the leadership rollup on Thu 12/10 by noon.

Attachments: Q4_OKR_evidence_request_v1.xlsx, scoring-rubric-one-pager.pdf
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drivex/Q4_OKR_evidence_sheet

Quick timeline:
- Tue 12/08 17:00 — internal calibration meeting (30m) if needed
- Wed 12/09 17:00 — final evidence & justifications due
- Thu 12/10 10:00 — leadership rollup distributed

Please confirm you have the sheet and whether you need more time. If you expect more than two KRs with contested scores, call it out now so we can schedule calibration.

Thanks —
Diego Fernandez
VP, Product Operations
Redwood Inference

Diego —

Thanks for the note. Quick clarifications so we align on a couple of KRs in Platform: 

1) KRs with shared ownership: For the "reduce p95 inference latency by 20%" KR, should we record the infra team's kernel-optimization contribution separately from the model-quantization gains? We have two distinct evidence artifacts (benchmark logs + PR references).

2) Revenue-adjacent usage KR: Should we include bookings from the Dec 1 pilot with Acme as evidence even though invoice recognition is in Jan? The pilot produced measurable usage uplift.

I'm attaching the Platform evidence stub in the sheet and include links to the two artifacts. If the rubric expects a single owner, I can nominate Marcus as primary and add attribution rows.

- p95 latency KR: evidence includes benchmark logs (bench_v2.json) and a PR link for the kernel change. Suggested split: list Marcus as owner, note "infra contribution: kernel optimizations (40% of delta)".

From: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.ai>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Cc: qbr-facilitator@consultco.com, molly@acme.ai
Date: Thu, 09 Dec 2026 15:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: End-of-Q4: OKR scoring, evidence collection, and narrative ask — consolidated decisions

Thanks for the quick turn. This is the consolidated leadership note after reviewing inputs across Platform, Infra, and Customer. I am publishing the leadership decisions below, and I've attached the draft QBR deck pointer.

Consolidated outcomes (final scores applied):
- Reduce p95 inference latency by 20% — FINAL SCORE: 2 (On-target). Rationale: combined evidence (bench_v2.json + PR #412 + internal dashboard) shows a 17% end-to-end improvement; infra and platform split ownership. Marcus listed as primary owner; annotation made that model quantization accounted for ~60% of the delta.
- Increase PLG signups by 35% — FINAL SCORE: 3 (Exceeded). Rationale: ACME pilot and organic retention uplift drove larger-than-expected conversion; bookings will be recognized in Jan but product-side evidence suffices for QBR narrative.
- Improve cache hit-rate to 85% — FINAL SCORE: 2 (On-target). Rationale: steady progress but low-hanging ops items slipped; remedial playbook documented.

Decisions / next steps:
- I will merge the evidence sheet into the QBR narrative doc and tag owners for the "judgement notes" section.
- Marcus, please prepare a 2-slide appendix on the kernel changes + perf graphs for the QBR.
- Laura, please own the customer pilot narrative; include a succinct timeline and the usage metric we will highlight (MRR uplift %).
- Vivek, we will have a 15-minute sync Thu 12/10 09:00 to review Marcus's appendix.

Attachments / links: qbr-deck-draft-link.txt -> https://docs.redwood.ai/drafts/qbr-deck-q4
Evidence sheet: https://drive.google.com/drivex/Q4_OKR_evidence_sheet

If there are material objections to scores/justifications, raise them before Thu 12/10 08:00 PST so I can decide whether we need a 30m calibration. Otherwise I will publish the rollup to the exec channel at 12:00.

Thanks all — good work closing the quarter.

Diego Fernandez
VP, Product Operations
Redwood Inference
